name: Ingestion health
description: Is the daily ingestion clock running? Mirrors `python -m src.pipeline.health` and docs/daily-operation.md.

cards.text:
## Ingestion health
**Sources:** `v_ingestion_daily` (built on job_snapshots, so days before the run log still show) and `v_ingestion_runs` (the run log).

**Mirrors:** the health check, `python -m src.pipeline.health`, and docs/daily-operation.md. Built first, per the roadmap: if this dashboard is wrong, every other one is too. Data window: see the card on the right.

cards.title: Data window
cards.description: First and last UTC snapshot date in the database and the n behind this dashboard (n_jobs = jobs first seen inside the window).

cards.title: Distinct jobs observed per day, by source
cards.description: Distinct jobs snapshotted per UTC day and source (v_ingestion_daily). A missing day is a gap in the line, never a zero.

cards.title: New jobs per day, by source
cards.description: Jobs whose first_seen_at falls on each UTC day (v_ingestion_daily.new_jobs).

cards.title: Adzuna API calls per day
cards.description: calls_made from the run log for source adzuna, retries included: the number billed against the 1,000-call monthly budget. Blank = no run row (before the run log existed).

cards.title: Runs by source and status
cards.description: Every ingestion run by final status (v_ingestion_runs): ok, partial (per-run cap hit), failed, skipped_budget (monthly cap reached, no call made), running (killed process).

cards.title: Current streak vs 60-day target
cards.description: Consecutive snapshot days ending today or yesterday (UTC), from v_ingestion_daily; n_snapshot_days counts every day with any snapshot.

cards.title: Missing days
cards.description: UTC days between the first and last snapshot with no snapshot at all. They are lost for good: a snapshot records what the APIs showed that day.

cards.text: **Reading gaps.** Snapshot dates are UTC dates. A missing day means no run succeeded for any source that day (laptop off, or every source failed) and cannot be backfilled. A dip for one source usually means a failed or budget-skipped run for that source: check *Runs by source and status*. Days before the run log existed show 0 runs and blank calls.
